title: Header::read does not check the file version; the open path does
body:
`SufrFile::read` stores the version byte (`libsufr/src/sufr_file.rs:145`, kept as `version` at 249) and never compares it with `OUTFILE_VERSION` (6, `libsufr/src/types.rs:16`). An older or newer file is read with the current layout. `util::read_text_length` (`libsufr/src/util.rs:95`) reads the same header at fixed offsets and also has no check that the survey could confirm.

Seen by reading the code in the survey. Not run against a file with another version.
close_reason: Fixed in fc5db36: Header::read bails with "Unknown sufr version N" on any version but OUTFILE_VERSION; test_header_round_trip checks the refusal.

notes.author: Jack Roddy/4be42394
notes.text:
At cff9fb6 the open path does check the version. `read_text_length` (`format.rs:226-230`) bails with "Unknown sufr version {n}", and every open goes through it (`lib.rs:65`). So `sufr list` and `sufr summarize` on a file with version byte 7 report that error.

`Header::read` (`format.rs:99`, version read at :135) still has no check. Its two direct callers are `io.rs:396` and `index.rs:187`.
